If someone questions a number: click a month above, or pick any date — the dashboard opens the underlying days and hours.

Every number on this page is computed live from the embedded hourly day-ahead prices (ENTSO-E Transparency Platform; DK1/DK2 hours in CET, RO hours in EET; 2015–2025 full years, 2026 through 15 Aug). Same data as the Excel files — daily lowest-3 / highest-4 convention. RO prices before Jun 2021 are RON→EUR converted at BNR annual-average FX (ENTSO-E published Romania in RON until SDAC go-live). 2021–2022 include the gas-crisis period; treat those spreads as exceptional.
